description: Bookable times for one interpreter, using Remoto's booking calendar rules. Most interpreters take scheduled-call requests instead of fixed slots (bookingRoute = scheduled_request): the person proposes a date, time and length and the interpreter confirms.

interpreter_id.description: Interpreter id: the number in the public profile URL (/profile/<id>), or the profile URL itself.

source.description: Language pair being booked (prices the slot).

target.description: Target language: a name ("Farsi", "Brazilian Portuguese", "ASL") or code ("fas", "spa", "ase").

timezone.description: IANA timezone for the returned times, e.g. America/New_York (default UTC).

to.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD (default from + 13 days, max 31 days).

name: get_open_slots
title: Get bookable times
